author: Nelev
body:
Wire medas-api to the local PostgreSQL 18 instance using SQLAlchemy's async engine, and add an Alembic-managed users table.

- app/config.py: settings from .env, DSN composed via URL.create() so the password needs no hand-escaping; password held as a SecretStr
- app/db.py: engine with pool_pre_ping, session factory, get_session dependency
- main.py: lifespan verifies connectivity at boot, GET /health/db for probes
- migrations/: Alembic wired to the same settings and metadata, with a render_item hook so pgvector types emit usable imports later
- revision 6f1a2b3c4d5e creates users: uuid pk defaulted to gen_random_uuid(), unique email, user_role enum, timestamptz created_at/updated_at
- ruff pinned as a dev dependency with an explicit rule selection, since ruff's defaults shift between releases

Uses asyncpg rather than psycopg3: psycopg3's async mode cannot run on Windows' default ProactorEventLoop, which is what uvicorn provides.
